en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a large, ornate brick public building with a clock in the central gable and mansard roof on the left, and a cobblestone street rising uphill between rows of smaller townhouses on the right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk; a horse‑drawn carriage stands near a corner building with a sign reading "Restaurant". Overhead electric wires cross the sky. The scene has the formal, documentary style typical of early European city postcards.
